name: YOLO26 People Analytics
description: Analytics plugin that forwards frames to the local Python people analytics service.

items.name: detection_frame_period
items.caption: Detection Frame Period
items.description: Run detection every Nth frame (2 = every other frame).

items.name: target_enqueue_fps
items.caption: Target Enqueue FPS
items.description: Max frame enqueue rate to AI worker. Use 2-3 on CPU/dev; 5-8 on AI Box after tuning.

items.name: frame_queue_max_size
items.caption: Frame Queue Max Size
items.description: Max buffered frames before dropping oldest (1 = prefer freshest frame).

items.name: metrics_log_period_sec
items.caption: Metrics Period (sec)
items.description: Periodic pipeline metrics interval.

items.name: service_host
items.caption: Service Host
items.description: Host name or IP address of the Python analytics service.

items.name: service_port
items.caption: Service Port
items.description: TCP port of the Python analytics service.

items.name: service_api_key
items.caption: Service API Key
items.description: Optional X-API-Key header value sent to the analytics service.

items.name: service_use_https
items.caption: Use HTTPS
items.description: Enable HTTPS when connecting to the analytics service.

items.name: service_connect_timeout_ms
items.caption: Connect Timeout (ms)
items.description: Socket connect timeout for analytics service requests.

items.name: service_read_timeout_ms
items.caption: Read Timeout (ms)
items.description: Response read timeout for analytics service requests.

items.name: service_write_timeout_ms
items.caption: Write Timeout (ms)
items.description: Request body write timeout for analytics service requests.

items.name: service_retry_count
items.caption: Retry Count
items.description: Number of retry attempts after the initial request.

items.name: service_retry_backoff_ms
items.caption: Retry Backoff (ms)
items.description: Delay between analytics service retry attempts.

items.name: debug_dump_enabled
items.caption: Debug Frame Dump Enabled
items.description: Enable frame dumping to disk for debugging (default off).

items.name: debug_dump_dir
items.caption: Debug Dump Directory
items.description: Relative path for debug frame dump directory.

items.name: debug_dump_input
items.caption: Debug Dump Input Frames
items.description: Dump input frames (when debug enabled).

items.name: debug_dump_output
items.caption: Debug Dump Output Frames
items.description: Dump output frames with bounding boxes (when debug enabled).

items.name: debug_dump_every_n_frames
items.caption: Debug Dump Every N Frames
items.description: Sample rate for frame dumping (1 = every frame, 10 = every 10th frame).

items.name: queue_depth_warn_pct
items.caption: Queue Depth Warning (%)
items.description: Emit a warning diagnostic when queue depth exceeds this percentage of its maximum capacity (0 = disabled).

items.name: drop_rate_warn_per_sec
items.caption: Drop Rate Warning (frames/sec)
items.description: Emit a warning diagnostic when the frame drop rate exceeds this threshold (0 = disabled).

items.name: health_poll_interval_sec
items.caption: Health Poll Interval (sec)
items.description: How often the plugin polls GET /health and emits diagnostic events on status changes.
